europe_now.title: EU Budget Summit Disruption
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders concluded a Brussels summit without securing a budget agreement following a walkout, leaving officials a single month to salvage a deal before a Christmas meeting.

top_stories.title: UK-EU Consultative Frameworks
top_stories.summary: New agreements being finalized will grant the United Kingdom consultative rights modeled after Switzerland under upcoming EU frameworks. These arrangements mark a shifting diplomatic dynamic between British and European authorities.
